tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Card, panel, and nav background.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken surfaces: table stripes, inputs, code blocks.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-100/200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps, chart axis labels.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Identity color: logo, primary button fill, active nav state, primary chart series. Constant across themes.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state for brand-filled elements.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Soft background behind brand-colored content: selected rows, highlighted chips.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a brand, positive, or negative solid fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Gold accent for premium/featured highlights and a secondary CTA — decorative, never a status signal. Don't substitute for warning.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state for accent-filled elements.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Soft gold background behind featured/highlighted content.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a solid accent fill. Fixed regardless of page theme, since the accent fill itself only flips light/dark, not warm/cool.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Interactive text and links directly on the page background (not inside a solid fill).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains, inflows, growing holder counts — as text, icons, or chart lines.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Background for positive badges and table rows.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses, outflows, shrinking holder counts — as text, icons, or chart lines.

tokens.name: negative-tint
tokens.usage: Background for negative badges and table rows.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Stale-data notices and caution states. Used sparingly.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring color, both themes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, tags, form labels — set in sentence case, not uppercase.

styles.name: mono-data
styles.usage: Token amounts, balances, and prices in tables and stat cards.

styles.name: mono-address
styles.usage: Wallet addresses and transaction hashes, usually truncated (0x71C7…9E4f).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight chip padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Compact stacks; gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Default gap between related inline controls.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card and input padding; default vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Hero and marketing section padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, dropdowns.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting elevation for cards on surface-100.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers, and hover-lifted cards.
